diagnosis: The checks C4 passed because the lone decision-maker used the fact 'PF2' (revised safety data sheet details) to justify segregated storage and hazardous waste handling, even though 'PF2' was owned by A3 and thus not accessible to the decision-maker who only had PF1. This indicates a structural leak where the model is defaulting to common practices like segregated storage and hazardous waste management, which do not require the hidden information.

C4.why: The revised safety data sheet changes storage from ordinary materials-cage storage to segregated labeled storage and changes disposal to a hazardous-waste manifest.
